title: 6 cyclic cube fields with weight-conditioned admission

claims.statement: The explicit 6-field degree-167 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-36 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 11277352406798093/200000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=292082966244132163508086726104042952789940905734626912368055036006 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(27184/125).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), field, orbit count and primitive bound (1), exact weight-indexed child admission (2), and final weighted balance and occupancy (3).
